nodes.summary: The series $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ of Ramanujan's general theta function is not summable at $a = b = 1$, since every one of its terms equals $1$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's theta series diverges at $a = b = 1$

nodes.summary: The raw Ramanujan theta sum $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$, which is assigned the value $0$ whenever the series is not summable, equals $0$ at $a = b = 1$, because there every term equals $1$ and the series is not summable.
nodes.title: The raw Ramanujan theta sum vanishes at $a = b = 1$

nodes.summary: For complex numbers $a$ and $b$, the raw Ramanujan theta sum is $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ when this series is summable, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Raw Ramanujan theta sum

nodes.summary: For all complex numbers $a$ and $b$ with $|ab| < 1$, the series $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} |a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}|$ of the absolute values of the terms of Ramanujan's general theta function converges.
nodes.title: Absolute convergence of Ramanujan's general theta series

nodes.summary: For complex numbers $a$, $b$ and an integer $n$, this is the term $a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ of index $n$ in Ramanujan's general theta function $f(a,b) = \sum_{k \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{k(k+1)/2} b^{k(k-1)/2}$.
nodes.title: Summand of Ramanujan's general theta function

nodes.summary: For complex numbers $a$ and $b$ such that the series $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ is summable, Ramanujan's general theta function is its sum $f(a,b) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's general theta function

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
